initiative.title: Diagram DSL concision
initiative.summary: Make the four diagram DSLs easier to predict and edit through one narrow canonical syntax.

sources.anchor: Make the DSL more concise or easier to use, test alternatives, and recommend the best path.
Executive decision; candidate score table; exact recommended syntax; proof plan.
Current aliases, reference forms, formatter behavior, and unsafe-path contract.
Fifteen diagram sources outside this repository are known local consumers.
Go ahead and implement those fixes.

claims.statement: Authors can predict, edit, and repair diagram source with fewer type-specific rules.
Concision means fewer rules and exceptions before it means fewer characters.
Use the Narrow canonical candidate as the working design.
Keep the shared envelope, explicit IDs, braces, typed relations, typed references, and explicit variant operations.
Human text and paths are quoted; identifiers, enums, booleans, and numbers are bare across all body types.
Wireframe formatting serializes the complete AST and supports semantic round-trip and idempotence checks.
Remove undocumented application cardinality aliases and the navigation label alias.
Use child flow and wireframe lines as the canonical base overview reference form.
Do not adopt indentation parsing, universal blocks, JSON/HCL source, contextual variants, generated IDs, or arbitrary wireframe styling.
Rewrite repository and known local consumer sources once after the proof passes.
Every wireframe screen must state its basis.
Unsafe overview paths fail parsing; safe missing or wrong targets remain warnings.

conflicts.resolution: Unsafe paths fail parsing. Safe missing, wrong-type, or missing-ID targets remain warnings.

brainstorm.note: ChatGPT Pro already compared six alternatives with the current DSL.

shape.appetite: One focused language cleanup with no new package and no compatibility layer.
shape.problem: The four DSL bodies express similar values with inconsistent quoting, escapes, aliases, option strictness, and canonical formatting.
shape.recommended_shape: Keep each body parser, share only the small lexical primitives that truly match, make both parser roots strict, and converge sources through canonical formatting.
success_moves: Keep body-specific tokenizers because their recovery and nesting rules differ.
Prove the lexical contract with cross-type tests before source rewrites.
Make wireframe formatting serialize the AST instead of retained source.
Migrate known sources once after parser behavior passes.
Keep unsafe paths as errors and safe broken targets as warnings.

first_proof.question: Can the current semantic models use one predictable lexical contract without weakening diagnostics or round trips?
first_proof.artifact: Focused parser and formatter tests across all four document types.
first_proof.decision_rule: Continue when bare identifiers, narrow escapes, explicit basis, strict aliases, and semantic round trips pass; revise if a real source requires a general exception.

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Only the diagram-dsl-concision intent artifacts are untracked at planning time.

fast_local_loop.slower_confirmation: pnpm test:overview, pnpm test:dsl, pnpm typecheck, pnpm check:flows, canonical corpus checks, and known consumer checks

milestones.title: The DSL has one predictable lexical contract
milestones.outcome: All body parsers use bare identifiers, narrow escapes, strict options, and documented canonical forms.
milestones.proof: Focused cross-type parser tests and current corpus parsing.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Existing semantic models and explicit IDs remain unchanged while noncanonical forms fail with diagnostics.
milestones.rollback: Revert parser and test changes before migrating sources.

milestones.title: Wireframes have real canonical output
milestones.outcome: The formatter serializes every wireframe AST field and no longer returns retained source.
milestones.proof: AST mutation, parse-format-parse equality, fixture coverage, and formatter idempotence.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Wireframes parse and render as before while their output becomes canonical.
milestones.rollback: Restore the prior formatter while retaining parser tests until the serializer is corrected.

milestones.title: Maintained documentation and known sources converge
milestones.outcome: The specification, authoring skill, repository fixtures, and known local consumers use the accepted canonical form.
milestones.proof: Byte-identical specifications, format checks, repository gates, and external consumer checks.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: The new parser and formatter are authoritative with no compatibility layer.
milestones.rollback: Revert source rewrites together with parser changes.
